name: Cinematic
idea: Full-bleed images and very few words on a dark ground, like a film title.
brief: A film title sequence. The image is the slide: full-bleed or most of the slide, with type on a solid band or in the dark ground beside it, never over a busy area. Very few words per slide; headlines short and set with restraint, often in the lower third. Labels small, spaced, in the label face. The ground is dark; the accent is used sparingly, like a single light in the frame. Numbers appear large and alone.

styles: cinematic photography, natural light, film grain, wide aspect
